answer: Grove nadir bond: each identity plants a cipher-sealed record in the grove, locking 50. Each epoch at the nadir hour, a 15-minute window opens and each files a cipher-sealed record naming its grove plot. A filing takes 75 seconds, so one operator manages 12; 1,000 fakes need 84 operators, 50,000 locked and 12,000 fees against a 40,000 pool. A reused seal or wrong grove plot burns it. An honest identity pays 12 once, recovers 50 after a clean one.
